title: get_current_region
description: Response returned for get_current_region. It provides the reader's current regulatory region settings and command execution status.

command.description: Echoes the command name so clients can map this response to the get_current_region request.

requestId.description: Request identifier copied from the command, used for request and response correlation.

apiVersion.description: API version used to interpret this response payload.

currentRegion.description: Current regulatory region information, including country, channels, and power limits.

response.description: Execution result object containing status code and result description.
